title: Hot-air balloon application
slide_intent: Adapt an identity to a curved object so its color and name remain recognizable at a large viewing distance.
strategic_value: The oversized symbol and wordmark can connect an aerial public encounter with Swisscom’s familiar identity.
demonstration: A white hot-air balloon fills the center against blue sky. Enlarged red and blue symbol surfaces wrap around the envelope beneath a dark Swisscom wordmark.
practical_value: Judge how the symbol’s scale and the wordmark’s position survive curvature and the object’s silhouette.

content_islands.name: Branded balloon envelope
content_islands.spec: Center the rounded white balloon and retain the enlarged red and blue surfaces wrapping around its panels.

content_islands.name: Wordmark and basket
content_islands.spec: Keep the dark Swisscom wordmark high on the envelope and the small basket below to preserve the relationship between recognition and physical scale.

content_islands.name: Sky field
content_islands.spec: Use the uninterrupted blue sky surrounding the balloon to keep its full outline readable.

ingredient.name: Large-scale symbol wrap
ingredient.role: Make the balloon identifiable through color and form before the name is read.
ingredient.application: Apply the enlarged symbol around the white balloon envelope and place the wordmark above it as shown.
ingredient.scope: One photographed balloon application; the image does not prescribe a general environmental-signage standard.

reference_purposes.Expression: The balloon extends the red-and-blue symbol across a large curved white surface.
reference_purposes.Application: The photograph shows the identity applied to a physical aerial object with a visible wordmark.
